description.value: Beachcomber Coffee is an award-winning specialty coffee roaster and cafe founded in 2015, operating two locations in Gibsons on BC's Sunshine Coast. The Lower Gibsons cafe, transformed from Truffles Cafe in 2018, anchors the brand and has been voted Favourite Food & Drink Producer on the Sunshine Coast three years running. It offers certified organic, fair trade, and kosher coffees alongside fresh donuts, and the same building hosts a boutique studio rental above the cafe.
